title: Tenant-slice rapid reconciliation and patch orchestration for cross-mode rollouts
creator: Maya Chen
description: When a recent model rollout showed degraded outputs for a subset of customers, we observed divergence between model variant routing and per-tenant KV/prefix caches across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. This ticket scopes a playbook to rapidly reconcile affected tenant slices, orchestrate a safe patch deployment across modes, and coordinate customer escalations and communications. Goals: 1) Minimize customer-visible errors for impacted tenants within the next 4 hours; 2) Provide a deterministic reconciliation sequence that avoids KV cache corruption or data residency violations; 3) Define orchestration primitives (pin, cutover, invalidate) that work across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private environments and can be executed by oncall and SREs with minimal friction.

Risk: blind rollback could leave unusable KV states. Action: do not perform blind global rollback; instead run 'tenant-slice reconciliation' to invalidate and rebuild KV/prefix caches before variant downgrade.

acceptance_criteria: Automated detection: alarm triggers when tenant-slice A/B error delta exceeds threshold for 5m.
Reconciliation CLI: 'reconcile-tenant' able to run dry-run and apply mode, producing deterministic report and exit codes.
Cross-mode orchestration: Hosted + Dedicated orchestration flows documented and tested in staging; Private runbook validated with two customers.
Customer comms: templated customer email + escalation path and compensation guidelines approved by Support and Product.
Post-deploy monitoring: KV-prefix-epoch mismatch metric and traffic-pin drift alerting enabled in runtime-1.20 release.
Runbook approvals: Dedicated pool owners have signed off on the drain-and-rebuild checklist in PR #10234.
